description.value: Black Frog Eatery is a sports bar, restaurant, and live entertainment venue perched on the edge of Gastown with waterfront views of Vancouver harbour. A long-standing local institution, it draws locals, tourists, and sports fans with multiple big screens, rotating BC craft beers, and a packed event calendar of live music, stand-up comedy, and trivia nights. Its all-season patio and hearty pub menu make it a lively food-and-drink anchor in one of Vancouver's most visited neighbourhoods.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM address (108 Cambie St., Vancouver, BC V6B 2M8), phone (604-602-0527), and URL. Takeout is explicitly confirmed via 'grabbing something to-go' and a prominent 'Order Online' feature. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: The refund policy page contains only a generic legal template placeholder rather than an actual refund policy, suggesting the website may be newly built or partially complete.
Website reveals an email address (blackfrogeatery@hotmail.com) not present in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is a legitimate, active pub and restaurant in Gastown, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking or visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from website content. On-site verification is needed before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM address field omits city and postal code; website provides the complete address as 108 Cambie St., Vancouver, BC V6B 2M8, which has been used here.

wow_evidence: perched on the edge of Gastown with waterfront views of Vancouver harbour
